entries.label: Head in 2015; 2013 Head who was mover-out nonresponse by the time of the 2015 interview
Legal Spouse in 2015; 2013 Spouse who was mover-out nonresponse by the time of the 2015 interview
entries.resolution: Max's ruling d1090 (2026-10-10; specification section 16c), section 16a option 1d-2, ratified as an explicit amendment to draft-3 line 160: 2015 code 20 occupies the spouse slot as documented, and every 2015 family-unit observation that contains a person recorded male (ER32000 = 1) with 2015 relationship code 20 is excluded from every row under the named disposition male code 20 in 2015 family unit. The rule is fixed before any count and is vacuous if no such unit supplies an observation; the count is disclosed after the authorized structural pass and decides nothing. This replaces the adjudication's refusal, kept as superseded_refusal; family_unit_exclusion.condition records that the exclusion concerns sex=1.
entries.superseded_refusal: Refused by the independent adjudication (EV/phase2-20260927/out/u2-adjudicate.md line 103; disposition F, amendment 1): q2015 pp. 89 and 166 gate the spouse income and pension loops on 'CYAQRTH=202, 222' and FAM2015ER ER60020 (p. 6) lists only '2 Female', so no documented family-file spouse-slot route exists for a male code-20 person. The refusal removes the asserted financial mapping, not the person; it does not authorize exclusion, zero-filling, reassignment or fallback. The loader refuses this whole entry; refusal_condition records that the gap concerns sex=1.
entries.part_b_finding: PARTIAL (u2-m1b Part B, docs/design/u2_m1b_psid_research.md section 1): official documentation routes every documented kind of male legal spouse in 2015 away from code 20. Through 2015 the husband of a heterosexual couple is Head (UserGuide2017 PDF p. 13; FAQ question 73), a husband who is not Head is 'Husband of Head' code 90 and 'was asked the same questions as an Ofum' (FAQ question 74), and 2015 same-sex partners are code 98 'Other nonrelatives (includes same-sex partners ...)' flagged by ER34304 (IND2023ER_codebook p. 978; UserGuide2015 PDF p. 33; UserGuide2017 PDF p. 35). The 2015 Section J qualifier classes values 102-222 as female, where the 2017 qualifier classes 101, 201 and 221 as male (research record section 1, item 11; q2015 p. 190; q2017 p. 184). No document states that code 20 is never male in 2015, and FAQ question 70 says generally that from 2015 a Spouse/Partner couple 'can consist of heterosexual or same sex couples', so the documents do not settle how a male Head's legally married same-sex spouse was coded. The 2015 'RTH Lookup List' named for CYAQRTH (q2015 p. 5) is absent from the staged documentation. PSID answered on 2026-10-07 that no male should have code 20 in 2015 (research record section 1), and Max ruled on 2026-10-10 (d1090; specification section 16c).
entries.open_question: In the 2015 wave, how was the legally married same-sex spouse of a male Head coded: Relation to Head ER34303 = 20 (and, if so, under which family-listing CYAQRTH value), or 98 with ER34304 = 1? If any 2015 code-20 person is male, in which family-file variables were his income, Social Security, SSI and employer-pension items stored, given that the 2015 spouse income and pension loops admit only CYAQRTH 202 and 222? And could PSID share the 2015 "RTH Lookup List" for the family-listing item CYAQRTH (q2015 p. 5), in particular whether it offered the value 201? (Question for PSID staff, docs/design/u2_m1b_psid_research.md section 1; sent 2026-09-30 and answered 2026-10-07 as that section records. Max's ruling d1090 settles U2's treatment by a population rule, not from observed records.)

entries.label: Uncooperative legal spouse of Head (this individual is unable or unwilling to be designated as Head)
entries.resolution: Independent adjudication D (amendment 1): OFUM income collection and exclusion from the standard spouse loop are documented. I p. 978: 'Uncooperative legal spouse of Head'. The 2015 spouse income and pension loops admit only the Wife/'Wife' codes (q2015 p. 89 G49CKPT and p. 166 P70CKPT: 'CYFUHU=1, 4 & CYAQRTH=202, 222'), while the Big OFUM income series admits 'FUP1YEAR[I].AQRTH.ORD>222' (q2015 p. 104). Code-90 income is collected in the OFUM series and excluded from the standard spouse loop. The declared legal-spouse annuity and marital-resolution conventions are unchanged.
entries.corroboration: Corroborated by the PSID FAQ (Wayback snapshot of 13 August 2026, question 74, saved-file line 833): 'From 1968 to 2015, ... the husband became Husband of Head. A Husband of Head was asked the same questions as an Ofum. A male Head could also have been made Husband of Head if the female half of the couple insisted on being the Head, the female half of the couple was adamant about not giving out information about her husband, or the husband was adamant about not wanting to be included in the study. A Husband of Head had the Relationship to Head code 9 or 90.' The route is documented; how completely a withheld husband's OFUM income was reported is not, and this resolution concerns routing, not how much is reported.

family_unit_exclusion.disposition: uncooperative spouse or partner in family unit

entries.resolution: Max's ruling d1090 (2026-10-10; specification section 16c), section 16a option 1e-1, ratified as an explicit amendment to draft-3 lines 152, 154 and 158 for 2019-2023: every 2019 family-unit observation that contains a code-90 or code-92 person is excluded from every row under the named disposition uncooperative spouse or partner in family unit, whether the target person is the reference person, the uncooperative spouse or partner, or another member. The rule is fixed before any count and is vacuous if no such unit supplies an observation; the count is disclosed after the authorized structural pass and decides nothing. No income, Social Security or SSI is assigned to the code-90 uncooperative legal spouse and no OFUM routing is asserted for them (income_role excluded). This replaces the adjudication's refusal, kept as superseded_refusal.
entries.superseded_refusal: Refused by the independent adjudication (EV/phase2-20260927/out/u2-adjudicate.md line 110; disposition F, amendment 1): the q2019 p. 103 Big OFUM gate admits 'CYAQRTH=301-882 or 951-982', excluding 901/902, and the spouse gate admits 201-222. The asserted OFUM financial assignment is refused. The refusal removes the mapping, not the person; it does not authorize exclusion, zero-filling, reassignment or fallback.
entries.part_b_finding: PARTIAL (u2-m1b Part B, docs/design/u2_m1b_psid_research.md): the instrument asks 901/902 no Section G income questions in 2019 (spouse series CYAQRTH=201-222; Big and Little OFUM series 301-882 or 951-982), and PSID FAQ question 74 says the code is used when one half of the couple withholds information about the other or refuses to have their information included. No online document states whether any of the person's income enters the family-file aggregates. PSID's 2026-10-07 answer confirmed that these persons are skipped out of the Section G income questions and did not say whether their income is edited or imputed into the family-file aggregates (research record section 2); Max ruled on 2026-10-10 (d1090; specification section 16c).
entries.open_question: In 2019, the Section G spouse series (CYAQRTH=201-222) and the Big and Little OFUM series (CYAQRTH=301-882 or 951-982) both exclude CYAQRTH 901/902. Is any income, Social Security or SSI of a relationship-code-90 person reported, edited or imputed into the family-file aggregates (total family income and its seven components), or is it excluded from them? (Question for PSID staff, docs/design/u2_m1b_psid_research.md section 2; sent 2026-09-30 and answered in part 2026-10-07 as that section records. Max's ruling d1090 excludes these family units, so U2 relies on no answer to it, and none is taken from observed records.)

(Question for PSID staff, docs/design/u2_m1b_psid_research.md section 2; sent 2026-09-30 and answered in part 2026-10-07 as that section records. Max's ruling d1090 excludes these family units, so U2 relies on no answer to it, and none is taken from observed records.)
